meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Embeds chat.deepseek.com and two-way bridges desktop conversations with the web chat: three chat entries, an optional auto-loop (web reply → desktop draft only), and a v1.4.0 full auto-pilot channel that extracts a delimited review block, auto-submits the next turn via official conversation.send and pauses on a decision card you control.
